native_result.query: In what context does the gardening pathway for introducing non-native plants show different prevalence styles across habitat types?
native_result.HypoA: The prevalence of gardening-introduced non-native plants differs between urban/cropland habitats and natural habitats.
native_result.HypoB: The gardening pathway's prevalence is context-dependent across habitat types: highest in semi-natural, low-urbanization, stream-adjacent habitats (Wetlands ~56%, Coastal ~54%) and lowest in the most agricultural and urbanized habitats (Croplands ~19%, Urban ~30%), a statistically significant habitat-by-pathway pattern (chi2=75.2, df=18, p=5.8e-9) that is associated with lower urban land cover (p~0.01) rather than with a simple urbanization effect.
native_result.WorkflowB: Parsed the four files with their true delimiters (invaded_niche and temporal are TAB; invasion_success is comma; phylogenetic tree is Newick). Verified internal consistency (n.gard+n.unint+n.agfo==n.total in all 632 rows). Aggregated pathway counts per habitat, computed gardening share = sum(n.gard)/sum(n.total) with Wilson 95% CIs, flagged low-confidence habitats (n.total<20), ran chi-square independence on habitat x pathway (all and robust subset), built a descriptive landscape-context table plus Pearson correlations and an exploratory plot-level binomial GLM (gardening vs non-gardening on n.total>0 plots), cross-checked with temporal trends and invasion_success. Executed script: final_analysis.py.

sub_hypo.text: Gardening-pathway prevalence is highest in semi-natural, low-urbanization, stream-adjacent habitats, with approximately 56% in Wetlands and 54% in Coastal habitats, and lowest in agricultural and urbanized habitats, with approximately 19% in Croplands and 30% in Urban habitats.
sub_hypo.context: Non-native plants across habitat types in Barcelona province; pathway counts aggregated by habitat.
sub_hypo.relations: Gardening prevalence, calculated as sum(n.gard)/sum(n.total) within each habitat, varies by habitat: Wetlands ~56%, Coastal ~54%, Urban ~30%, and Croplands ~19%.

sub_hypo.text: Habitat type and introduction pathway exhibit a statistically significant association.
sub_hypo.context: Non-native plants in Barcelona province; habitat-by-pathway counts tested for independence across all habitats and a robust subset, with habitats having n.total < 20 flagged as low-confidence.
sub_hypo.relations: Pathway composition differs significantly across habitats (chi-square = 75.2, df = 18, p = 5.8e-9).

sub_hypo.text: Gardening-pathway prevalence is associated with lower urban land cover rather than a simple urbanization effect, within a habitat-dependent pattern characterized by high prevalence in stream-adjacent, low-urbanization habitats.
sub_hypo.context: Non-native plants in Barcelona province; descriptive landscape comparisons and Pearson correlations, with an exploratory plot-level binomial GLM restricted to plots with n.total > 0.
sub_hypo.relations: Gardening prevalence is associated with lower urban land cover (p ~ 0.01), and high-prevalence habitats are described as stream-adjacent. The hypothesis and workflow do not specify which urban-cover year or buffer scale underlies the reported association.
